assumptions: The nuclease's PAM and spacer length are the registry's.
On-target scores are the published models' (Rule Set 3, DeepHF, DeepSpCas9) within their trained scope.
limits: Off-target specificity here is against the sequence searched, not a genome; it says so rather than inventing a genome-wide number.
A score is a prediction from screens of other guides, not a measurement of this one.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which CRISPR guides can be made against this target, and how good is each one on-target and off-target?

description: Design and score CRISPR guides on the subject — on/off-target scores, QC flags, and cloning-enzyme conflicts. Nuclease list comes from the real nuclease registry.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

min_stem.description: minimum self-complementary stem to report. In nt. Advanced.

nuclease.description: the nuclease (PAM + spacer length) to scan for. Values: SpCas9 (SpCas9: NGG (3')), SpCas9-NG (SpCas9-NG: NG (3')), SpG (SpG: NGN (3')), SpRY (SpRY: NRN (3')), xCas9 (xCas9: NG (3')), SaCas9 (SaCas9: NNGRRT (3')), SaCas9-KKH (SaCas9-KKH: NNNRRT (3')), AsCas12a (AsCas12a: TTTV (5')), LbCas12a (LbCas12a: TTTV (5')), enAsCas12a (enAsCas12a: TTTV (5')).

region_end.description: restrict results to guides ending at/before this position. In bp. Advanced.

region_start.description: restrict results to guides starting at/after this position (0-based). In bp. Advanced.

restriction_enzymes.description: cloning enzymes whose recognition site must NOT appear in the spacer. Advanced.

name: crispr_design_guides

region.description: the window the guides were filtered to, resolved: start, end, and whether it is the whole molecule. Reported because `region_start`/`region_end` are optional and their default is the molecule's length, which a caller holding only this result does not have — without it, `count` of `totalCandidates` cannot be read
